comments.story: Compiling a Subset of APL into a Typed Intermediate Language (2014) [pdf]
comments.why: APL code translated to Julia and JIT compiled to machine code
comments.text: Reminds me of the APL interpreter in Julia ( [VIDEO] ). The APL code gets translated to Julia data structures, which is then mapped to Julia code, which is then compiled to machine code via Julia's JIT. I thought it was a pretty neat way to run APL.
